verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe OpenHands Cloud as the managed commercial service for running OpenHands without operating your own backend and sandbox infrastructure. Pricing pages add hosted cloud access from desktop and mobile plus API support for automation, and the GitHub README lists cloud backends alongside local and remote ones. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud service, and in-depth documentation of how the managed cloud handles scaling or running agents in parallel.
